blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Erwin Tulfo on Monday pressed the need for a more effective implementation of laws that protect persons with disabilities (PWDs) after a derogatory remark was made against Joshua “Josh” Aquino in a podcast. Tulfo sought a review to the implementation of the laws, including the Magna Carta for Persons with Disabilities that prohibits mocking, or uttering slanderous statements against PWDs, after Aquino became the subject of such remarks in a now-deleted episode of “Machong Chismisan” podcast. “Kung ang isang PWD mula sa isang kilalang pamilya ay maaaring makaranas ng ganitong diskriminasyon, paano pa kaya ang ating mga […]...
